now.title: Inhumans
now.text: In episode 7, Ambushed on Oahu, Triton leaps into the ocean and is feared dead. He returns alive and captures Maximus for Black Bolt.

changes.evidence: Inhumans episode 7 ('Havoc in the Hidden Land'): Triton reunites with the Royal Family, who return to Attilan for a parley; there Triton kills Maximus' bodyguards, captures him and sends him back to Black Bolt. The record's last event happens on Attilan, which is not listed.

now.title: The Punisher (2004)
now.text: Frank turns Saint against those closest to him, then drags him to his death behind a car.
cases: PR-005 The Fall of the Saints (The Punisher (2004))

proposed.text: Frank turns Saint against those closest to him, then ties him to a car that rolls into a parking lot rigged with explosives, and Saint dies in the blast.

changes.evidence: The Punisher (2004): after shooting Saint in a duel, Castle ties him to a car and sends it into the club's parking lot, which is rigged with explosives; Saint perishes in the ensuing explosion, not from being dragged.
